title: Robustness in Mechanism Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.01805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The article reviews the robust design and analysis of auctions, focusing on the predominant paradigm in the computer science literature, which quantifies robustness by the worst-case, over environments, ratio between the robust auction's performance and that of an optimal auction for the environment. Applications include robust analysis of canonical auctions such as the first-price auction for the welfare objective, prior-robust auction design for the revenue objective, and prior-robust design of exchange mechanisms for the gains-from-trade objective. Finally, the revelation principle is not without loss in robust mechanism design. The potential loss can be quantified by the revelation gap, the fraction of the optimal robust guarantee that is lost when restricting from all mechanisms to revelation mechanisms.

translated_abstract: 本文综述了拍卖的鲁棒设计与分析，聚焦于计算机科学文献中的主流范式，该范式通过在环境上取最坏情况下的比率来量化鲁棒性，即鲁棒拍卖的表现与该环境下最优拍卖表现之比。应用包括对经典拍卖的鲁棒性分析，例如面向福利目标的一价拍卖、面向收益目标的先验鲁棒拍卖设计，以及面向交易收益目标的先验鲁棒交换机制设计。最后，文章指出显示原理在鲁棒机制设计中并非无损，其潜在损失可以通过“显示差距”来量化，即从所有机制限制为显示机制时所损失的、占最优鲁棒保证的比例。
tldr: 本文综述了以最坏情况比率量化鲁棒性的拍卖设计与分析范式及其在福利、收益和交易收益目标上的应用，并指出显示原理在鲁棒机制设计中有损失，该损失可用“显示差距”量化。
en_tdlr: This article reviews robust auction design and analysis under the worst-case ratio paradigm, with applications to welfare, revenue, and gains-from-trade objectives, and shows that the revelation principle entails a loss in robust mechanism design, quantified by the revelation gap.
